# Confirm restored workspaces survive closing and reopening the browser

## What & Why
The restore flow is now covered through in-app navigation and page reloads. A browser restart is a separate persistence boundary and should be covered so users do not lose a restored workspace between sessions.

## Done looks like
- Restore a workspace in a browser context with persistent storage
- Close and reopen the page or browser context
- Verify the restored profile, answer library, and application queue are still present

- artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts
- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/lib/storage.ts
